newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities market closed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities market closed.

text.p: The Singapore government securities market is closed from Friday, February 7 to Monday, February 10 for the Chinese Lunar New Year and Moslem Hari Raya Puasa holidays.
It will reopen on Tuesday, February 11.

On Thursday, in treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.25/1.20 percent compared with Wednesday's yield of 1.26/1.21 percent and one-year at a yield of 1.75/1.70 percent against 1.81/1.76 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$98.68/98.73 from Wednesday's close of S$98.60/98.65, September 2001 at S$97.40/97.45 versus S$97.35/97.40 and June 2003 at S$95.40/95.45 against S$95.35/95.40.
The overnight interbank offered rate slipped to 1 7/8 percent from 1-5/8 1-1/2 percent.
